claim_boundary: all dates are historical and not independent OOS
the exact 20-session 15-percent target-volatility rule is frozen before its path is inspected
2024plus is opened only after a complete development pass and remains retrospective
a pass creates a prospective forward-test candidate only
a failure ends same-sample strategy mining and requires new immutable data

overlay.signal_baseline_cost: fixed primary F path with buy 15bp and sell 25bp; the same exposure schedule is reused in cost stress
overlay.signal_time: weekly decision close using returns through that close
overlay.warmup: cash until 20 finite F close-to-close returns exist

execution.sleeve_accounting: F overnight and intraday NAV returns split at exact daily open NAV; exposure changes only at next decision open

decision_rules.development_pass: average exposure in [25%,95%]; candidate annualized return>0; drawdown magnitude reduced>=15%; Sharpe improves>=0.15; annualized return no more than 1pp below F; weekly paired noninferiority HAC p<0.05
decision_rules.validation_opening: no validation path or statistics unless every development gate passes
decision_rules.validation_pass: same rules plus both locked subperiod candidate total returns>0 and paired total returns>=-2pp
decision_rules.cost_stress_pass: at 60bp candidate annualized return>0 and drawdown lower than F in both development and validation
